summary: Land acquisition dispute concerning Industrial Model Township, Rohtak across multiple villages (Kheri Sadh First Phase, Kheri Sadh Second Phase, Baliyana). First Phase acquisition involved 126 acres, 7 kanals, 10 marlas via notification dated 9.6.2006 under Land Acquisition Act, 1894. Reference Court awarded Rs.24,00,000/- per acre for highway-adjacent land (up to 1 acre) with 20% cut, and Rs.19,77,000/- for remainder with 38% cut. High Court increased highway land compensation to Rs.28,69,910/- by reducing cut to 10%, affirmed Rs.19,77,000/- for other land. Second Phase acquisition (notification dated 13.02.2008) received 12% escalation from High Court, resulting in Rs.30,89,066/- and Rs.28,08,242/- per acre respectively. For Baliyana village (same notification date 9.6.2006), Reference Court awarded Rs.17,00,000/- per acre (higher than L.A.O.'s Rs.16,00,000/-); High Court confirmed this. Petitioners challenged inadequate compensation; State contested awards in First Phase. Key issues: appropriate land valuation methodology, relevant sale exemplars, proper cut percentages, escalation for time gaps between acquisitions. Judgment upheld High Court's compensation for Baliyana and Second Phase, partially allowed appeals for First Phase highway land.
final_judgment: Interlocutory Application No. 33721/2022 allowed; proforma respondents' names ordered to be deleted. Common judgment disposing all appeals: Baliyana compensation confirmed at Rs.17,00,000/- per acre; Second Phase compensation upheld at Rs.30,89,066/- (highway) and Rs.28,08,242/- per acre (remainder); First Phase highway land compensation enhanced to Rs.28,69,910/- per acre with 10% cut, but Rs.19,77,000/- per acre maintained for non-highway land.
